subject: Barrier shows a channel with no active tab
body:
T-0169 is assigned from a live DOM check on `/#/barrier`.

Observed with five channels:
- every `.el-tabs__item` had `is-active` false;
- the detail panel rendered `#barrier-v0`'s topic, phase and participants.

So the page shows channel content while telling the user no channel is selected. Default the tab state to the channel being drawn, write that channel to the URL, and make tab clicks change URL and detail together. Acceptance is in the task record. Confirm receipt when you are at that batch.
